name: Probability Terminology and Sample Spaces
description: Introduces basic probability concepts and the sample space for experiments.

subtopics.name: Sample Space
subtopics.description: Defines sample space for discrete and continuous experiments.

subtopics.name: Events and Probability Measure
subtopics.description: Defines events as subsets and probability as a measure.

name: Probability Axioms and Rules
description: Covers the axioms of probability and basic rules for calculating probabilities.

subtopics.name: Probability Axioms
subtopics.description: States the three axioms of probability.

subtopics.name: Basic Probability Rules
subtopics.description: Applies axioms to derive complement and addition rules.

name: Conditional Probability and Bayes' Rule
description: Introduces conditional probability and its use in inference via Bayes' rule.

subtopics.name: Conditional Probability
subtopics.description: Defines conditional probability and the multiplication rule.

subtopics.name: Total Probability and Bayes' Rule
subtopics.description: Uses partitions to compute total probability and update beliefs.

name: Independence
description: Explores independence of events and its implications.

subtopics.name: Independence of Collections
subtopics.description: Extends independence to multiple events and distinguishes from pairwise.

name: Counting and Uniform Probability Laws
description: Covers uniform probability laws and counting outcomes.

subtopics.name: Discrete Uniform Law
subtopics.description: Probability as ratio of counts for equally likely outcomes.

subtopics.name: Continuous Uniform Law
subtopics.description: Probability as area for continuous sample spaces.

name: Visualization Tools: Tree and Venn Diagrams
description: Uses tree and Venn diagrams to visualize probability problems.

subtopics.name: Tree Diagrams
subtopics.description: Represents sequential experiments with branches and probabilities.

subtopics.name: Venn Diagrams
subtopics.description: Represents events as sets and their relationships.

name: Contingency Tables and Empirical Probability
description: Uses contingency tables and empirical data to estimate probabilities.

subtopics.name: Contingency Tables
subtopics.description: Organizes data to calculate conditional and joint probabilities.

subtopics.name: Empirical vs Theoretical Probability
subtopics.description: Compares observed frequencies with theoretical probabilities.
